title: SEBI Swing Pricing CEL Rules Specification
description: Defines deterministic Common Expression Language (CEL) policy configurations for SEBI Swing Pricing and DPDP compliance.

rules.name: Scheme Exemption Policy
rules.description: Checks if a mutual fund scheme is exempt from swing pricing (Overnight, Gilt, Gilt with 10-year maturity, and Liquid as per stress engine specs).
rules.expected_evaluation: Returns true if the scheme is exempt, false otherwise.

rules.name: Retail Investor Exemption Policy
rules.description: Checks if the redemption transaction is exempt from swing pricing under the retail threshold (up to INR 2 Lakhs / 200,000).
rules.expected_evaluation: Returns true if the transaction is a retail redemption <= 200,000 INR and thus exempt.

rules.name: Market Dislocation Mandatory Swing Eligibility
rules.description: Determines if the scheme is subject to mandatory swing pricing during a declared market dislocation based on high-risk Potential Risk Class (PRC) cells.
rules.expected_evaluation: Returns true if market dislocation is active and the scheme falls under a high-risk PRC class.

rules.name: DPDP Aadhaar Leak Detection
rules.description: Detects unmasked 12-digit Aadhaar numbers in input fields for DPDP Act 2023 compliance auditing.
rules.expected_evaluation: Returns true if an unmasked 12-digit Aadhaar is detected.

rules.name: DPDP PAN Leak Detection
rules.description: Detects unmasked 10-character PAN strings in input fields for DPDP Act 2023 compliance auditing.
rules.expected_evaluation: Returns true if an unmasked 10-character PAN is detected.
